name: Creativity
description: Lateral thinking, idea generation under extreme constraint, analogy synthesis, and novelty.

dimensions.name: Ideation Under Constraints
dimensions.description: Generating 10 non-obvious solutions when normal tools or capital are banned.

rubricCriteria.90-100: Turns harsh constraint into the primary competitive advantage; highly original.
rubricCriteria.70-89: Multiple creative workarounds with minor conventional spillover.
rubricCriteria.50-69: Offers cliché or derivative answers that barely circumvent constraints.
rubricCriteria.0-49: Complains about constraints; fails to generate viable alternatives.

dimensions.name: Cross-Domain Lateral Synthesis
dimensions.description: Borrowing mechanisms from biology, physics, or game theory to solve commercial problems.

rubricCriteria.90-100: Brilliant cross-pollination; maps mechanics from unrelated domain seamlessly.
rubricCriteria.70-89: Good analogical reasoning with slight stretching of domain logic.
rubricCriteria.0-49: Inability to look beyond immediate industry boundaries.
